# x402-suretat — Pay-per-use API microservices

> 47 developer utility APIs using the x402 protocol. Pay in USDC on Base mainnet. No API keys, no signup, no rate limits.

Source code: https://github.com/fredericsuretat/x402-suretat
All live at: https://x402-<name>.suretat.com

## How to use

1. Call any endpoint without payment → receive HTTP 402 with payment details
2. Use an x402 client to auto-pay and retry:
   - JS: `x402-fetch` or `x402-axios` (npm)
   - Python: `x402` (pip)
   - MCP: `services/x402-mcp/` for Claude/AI agents

Payment: USDC on Base mainnet. Wallet: `0x6458941857a70C6cA18c440a316035A21901A12b`

## Service catalogue

Each service: `POST /<endpoint>` (paid), `GET /health`, `GET /stats`, `GET /docs`, `GET /.well-known/x402.json`

### French Data Services
- https://x402-adresses.suretat.com — Address validation & geocoding (adresse.data.gouv.fr). POST /validate. 0.001 USDC
- https://x402-siret.suretat.com — SIRET/SIREN company lookup (INSEE). POST /lookup. 0.002 USDC
- https://x402-iban.suretat.com — IBAN validation & BIC lookup. POST /validate. 0.0005 USDC
- https://x402-geocoder-fr.suretat.com — French geocoding with commune/département. POST /geocode. 0.001 USDC
- https://x402-email-validator.suretat.com — Email validation with DNS MX check & disposable detection. POST /validate. 0.001 USDC
- https://x402-phone-fr.suretat.com — French phone validation (E.164, carrier, region). POST /validate. 0.0005 USDC
- https://x402-insee-fr.suretat.com — INSEE commune & département statistics. POST /commune, POST /departement. 0.002 USDC
- https://x402-vat-fr.suretat.com — French VAT calculation & invoice breakdown. POST /calculate, POST /invoice. 0.0005 USDC
- https://x402-feries.suretat.com — French public holidays all 11 zones. POST /feries, POST /jours-ouvres. 0.0005 USDC
- https://x402-fakedata-fr.suretat.com — French synthetic data (persons, companies, IBAN). POST /generate. 0.001 USDC
- https://x402-translate-fr.suretat.com — Translation via DeepL (30 languages, 5000 chars). POST /translate. 0.001 USDC
- https://x402-whois-fr.suretat.com — WHOIS for .fr & generic domains. POST /lookup. 0.001 USDC
- https://x402-ipgeo.suretat.com — IP geolocation (country, city, ISP, coordinates). POST /geolocate. 0.001 USDC

### Encoding & Crypto

- https://x402-base64.suretat.com — Base64/Base64url/Base32/Base16/URL encode+decode. POST /encode, POST /decode. 0.0005 USDC
- https://x402-uuid.suretat.com — UUID v1/v4/v5/v7 generation (up to 100/call). POST /generate. 0.0005 USDC
- https://x402-jwt.suretat.com — JWT decode/verify (HMAC, RSA, ECDSA). POST /decode, POST /verify. 0.0005 USDC
- https://x402-password.suretat.com — Password generation & zxcvbn strength scoring. POST /generate, POST /check. 0.0005 USDC

## MCP integration (for Claude / AI agents)

The `x402-mcp` service exposes all tools as MCP tools. Add to your Claude config:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "x402-suretat": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["services/x402-mcp/index.mjs"],
      "env": { "PRIVATE_KEY": "0x..." }
    }
  }
}
```
